name: Tatsunami Hibiki
source:
Protagonist of Muv-Luv Unlimited: The Day After - Episodes 01~03 and Muv-Luv Resonative.

1st lieutenant of the 1st Tactical Armor Regiment in the Imperial Japanese Army/Mainland Defense Force. Flight leader of the VF-17 Wardog squad based in Seattle.
